_README: Edit this file to change any homepage with NO app update. Top-level keys are the providers: Netflix, Prime, DisneyPlus, Hotstar, Nostalgia. Under each, add rows in customRows: [{ title, ids[], provider? }]. For OTTs use that provider's ids (Netflix/Prime ids differ). For Nostalgia, ids are the on-device catalog slugs (e.g. tom-and-jerry, looney-tunes) and rows render as horizontal carousels above the grid. top10 / top10Series / top10Movies / newThisWeek are optional overrides; omit to keep the automatic ones. Users get changes on next launch (1h cache).
